explanation: I grepped for lhopital_zero_left_on_Ioo across Mathlib. The only other declaration with that name is HasDerivAt.lhopital_zero_left_on_Ioo (line 103 of the same file), which is the lemma the target's proof already calls. It assumes HasDerivAt f (f' x) x and HasDerivAt g (g' x) x at every point of Ioo a b. The target has different hypotheses: DifferentiableOn f, and g' stated as deriv g ≠ 0. To get from one to the other you must show f is differentiable at each point, using that Ioo is a neighbourhood, and show g is differentiable by contradiction from deriv g ≠ 0. That is more than two short lines, so it is not a special case. I found no other left-limit L'Hôpital lemma in terms of deriv.
